output.title: podclip: Auto Viral Podcast Clips
output.tagline: AI that finds your best moments & makes them social-ready.
output.description_short: Turn full podcast episodes into captioned social clips automatically — and actually picks the good moments. Try free.
output.description_long:
podclip ingests a podcast episode and returns a set of captioned, vertically-framed clips ready for TikTok, Reels, Shorts, and X. Its hook-detection model was tuned on 40,000 manually rated clips, so it selects moments with narrative tension — not random 60-second windows.

No more hours of manual clipping. podclip renders your clips in about 90 seconds for a 60-minute episode, with per-show caption styles baked in so every clip looks on-brand, every time.

Used by 120+ shows weekly to turn episodes into shareable content without hiring an editor. Perfect for independent podcasters and small production teams who need consistent, high-quality clips but don’t have the time or budget.

Start with 3 free clips per month. Upgrade to unlock more renders, faster processing, and advanced styling options.
